Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Computing & programming

mailing list noun

also recipient list

our formation

catalogus dēstinātāriōrum

recipient list

Our descriptive “recipient list” from the email-platform discussion. catalogus, catalogī m. — catalogue or list; dēstinātārius, dēstinātāriī m. is modern vocabulary for a recipient; the full phrase is not claimed as an established platform label.

Other words

  • grex Internetī

    also used · modern · Vocabula computatralia s.v. list

    The computing glossary instead proposes grex Internetī for a mailing list. That emphasizes a group; an email-marketing platform’s stored list of recipients can be described more directly with catalogus. These alternatives need not name exactly the same kind of resource.

Examples

  • Catalogum īnspiciam.

    I’ll inspect the list.composed

  • Hunc dēstinātārium catalogō adde.

    Add this recipient to the list.composed

SourcesLewis & Short: catalogus · Vocabula computatralia: list. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
